title: Functions and Reusable Logic
learning_outcomes: Explain the main ideas in Functions and Reusable Logic and correctly use the key terms in context.
Build or inspect a minimal Solidity example that demonstrates the lesson concepts.
Test representative failure cases and describe version, security, or operational assumptions where relevant.

overview_visual.alt_text: A two-column ordered roadmap for Module 6: Functions and Reusable Logic; it lists all 13 source-syllabus lesson topics by number.
overview_visual.caption: Module 6 roadmap: Defining and Calling Functions; Function Parameters and Return Values; Named Return Variables; Function Visibility: public , external , internal , and private; State Mutability: pure , view , and State-Changing Functions; Default Values and Optional-Looking Call Patterns; Function Overloading; Internal and External Function Calls; Function Modifiers; The virtual and override Keywords; Function Pointers and Function Types; Recursive Functions and Their Practical Limitations; Designing Small, Reusable Functions. Work through the topics in order, then implement a small example and verify assumptions.
